description: Four-panel composite of scatter plots (OIM-EBSD-quantified microstructural features) sharing the x-axis "Heat treatment temperature (K)" (873–1273 K), with data points at 973 K, an intermediate temperature between the 973 and 1073 K gridlines, and 1173 K. The same legend is used in all panels: black squares = 28Mn0Ni, red circles = 28Mn5Ni, blue triangles = 15Mn5Ni. (a) "Fraction of recrystallized austenite" (0.0–1.0): 28Mn0Ni rises to sit on the 1.0 gridline at 1173 K, while both Ni-bearing alloys stay near zero at 973 K and only reach the 0.4–0.5 interval at 1173 K, with 15Mn5Ni slightly above 28Mn5Ni. (b) "Grain size of recry. austenite (μm)" (0–70): 28Mn0Ni reaches the 40 μm gridline at 1173 K with an error bar spanning roughly the 30–50 μm gridlines, whereas 28Mn5Ni and 15Mn5Ni stay at or below the few-μm level at all temperatures. (c) "Twin fraction" (0.0–0.8): 28Mn0Ni climbs from below the 0.1 gridline at 973 K to just under the 0.6 gridline at 1173 K, versus upper-0.2–0.4 interval for 28Mn5Ni and the 0.2 gridline for 15Mn5Ni. (d) "B2 phase volume fraction" (0.0–0.5): 15Mn5Ni falls from the 0.4 gridline at 973 K to between the 0.1 and 0.2 gridlines at 1173 K; horizontal broken lines labelled "HR (15Mn5Ni)" and "HR (28Mn5Ni)" mark the prior-phase B2 fractions. The panels jointly show that Ni-bearing LDS alloys retain fine recrystallized grains and higher B2 fractions, delaying recrystallization.

subfigures.description: Scatter plot of fraction of recrystallized austenite (y, 0.0–1.0) versus heat treatment temperature (K, 873–1273). 28Mn0Ni (black squares) sits near the 0.4 gridline at 973 K, between 0.8 and 1.0 at the intermediate temperature, and on the 1.0 gridline at 1173 K; 28Mn5Ni (red circles) and 15Mn5Ni (blue triangles) remain near zero at 973 K and only reach roughly the 0.4–0.5 interval at 1173 K, with the triangle marginally above the circle.

Scatter plot of grain size of recrystallized austenite (μm, 0–70) versus temperature. 28Mn0Ni shows a large jump to the 40 μm gridline at 1173 K with an error bar spanning about the 30–50 μm gridlines; 28Mn5Ni and 15Mn5Ni remain at a few μm at every temperature. Legend identical to (a).

Scatter plot of twin fraction (0.0–0.8) versus temperature. 28Mn0Ni increases from just below the 0.1 gridline at 973 K to just below the 0.6 gridline at 1173 K; 28Mn5Ni is near zero at 973 K and the intermediate temperature, rising into the upper part of the 0.2–0.4 interval at 1173 K; 15Mn5Ni lies on the 0.2 gridline at 1173 K.

Scatter plot of B2 phase volume fraction (0.0–0.5) versus temperature, with two horizontal broken reference lines: a blue dashed line between the 0.1 and 0.2 gridlines labelled "HR (15Mn5Ni)" and a red dashed line between 0.0 and 0.1 labelled "HR (28Mn5Ni)". 15Mn5Ni falls from the 0.4 gridline at 973 K through the 0.3 gridline to between 0.1 and 0.2 at 1173 K; 28Mn5Ni stays near the 0.1 gridline; 28Mn0Ni drops from about 0.05 to the 0.0 axis at 1173 K.

observations.observation: All four panels plot the same three alloys with the legend 28Mn0Ni (black squares), 28Mn5Ni (red circles) and 15Mn5Ni (blue triangles) against "Heat treatment temperature (K)" on a 873–1273 K axis.
In (a) the 28Mn0Ni point at 1173 K lies on the 1.0 gridline of "Fraction of recrystallized austenite", i.e. full recrystallization.
In (a) the 15Mn5Ni point at 1173 K lies slightly above the 28Mn5Ni point, showing a reversal in recrystallized austenite fraction between the two Ni-bearing alloys at the highest temperature.

In (b) the 28Mn0Ni point at 1173 K lies on the 40 μm gridline of "Grain size of recry. austenite (μm)" and carries an error bar spanning approximately the 30 to 50 μm gridlines, whereas 28Mn5Ni and 15Mn5Ni remain at a few μm at all three temperatures.
In (c) twin fraction rises most strongly in 28Mn0Ni (to just below the 0.6 gridline at 1173 K) and is near zero for both Ni-containing alloys at 973 K and the intermediate temperature.
In (d) the 15Mn5Ni series falls from the 0.4 gridline (973 K) through the 0.3 gridline (intermediate temperature) to between the 0.1 and 0.2 gridlines (1173 K) of "B2 phase volume fraction".
Panel (d) contains two horizontal broken lines labelled "HR (15Mn5Ni)" (blue dashed, between the 0.1 and 0.2 gridlines) and "HR (28Mn5Ni)" (red dashed, between 0.0 and 0.1).
In (d) 28Mn0Ni shows the lowest B2 volume fraction at every temperature, dropping from about 0.05 to the 0.0 axis line at 1173 K, while 28Mn5Ni stays close to the 0.1 gridline.

The caption states that the figure shows the variation in (a) recrystallization fraction of austenite, (b) grain size of recrystallized austenite, (c) twin fraction and (d) secondary B2 phase fraction in 28Mn0Ni, 28Mn5Ni and 15Mn5Ni alloys as a function of heat treatment temperature.

The citing text reports that the volume fraction of B2 particles in 15Mn5Ni decreased drastically from ~40% to ~15% with increase in heat treatment temperature from 973 K to 1173 K, while the fraction decreased only slightly in the other two alloys.
The citing text states that the volume fraction of prior B2 phase in both 28Mn5Ni and 15Mn5Ni is reported with horizontal broken lines in Fig. 5d.
The citing text states that the recrystallization fraction was calculated based on KAM maps as well as GOS <2° criteria.

The citing text attributes the reversal in recrystallized austenite fraction at 1173 K to the high rate of reduction in B2 volume fraction in 15Mn5Ni, and notes that no noticeable growth of recrystallized grains occurred in Ni-containing LDS alloys up to 1173 K.

The citing text notes that the total B2 volume fraction consists of stringer, intragranular and intergranular types, and that only type-1 and type-3 particles characterized at EBSD scale were included in the volume-fraction measurement.
